# Architecture Recommendation

Based on the stated constraints, I recommend a **modular, layered architecture with clear separation of concerns** (e.g., API layer, business logic, data access) that prioritizes maintainability and cost-efficiency as valued by your stakeholder. This approach should incorporate caching strategically (your current 0.91 cache hit ratio validates this) and containerization (your healthy pod status confirms this works well). Ensure all UI components meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards through accessible component libraries and automated testing in your CI/CD pipeline.

**Note:** The current system metrics (38% CPU, 51% memory, 142ms latency) indicate healthy performance, so focus architectural decisions on maintainability and operational simplicity rather than performance optimization.
